## #1 Downloading Data and Libraries

Loading libraries, creating paths fo files, creating paths to outputs, and setting the threshold for what is considered ERBB2 amplification in cell lines (ModelIDs).

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggthemes)
library(scales)

CRISPR_PATH   <- "/Users/jkeane/Desktop/Literature Review/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv"
HOTSPOT_PATH  <- "/Users/jkeane/Desktop/Literature Review/OmicsSomaticMutationsMatrixHotspot.csv"
DAMAGING_PATH <- "/Users/jkeane/Desktop/Literature Review/OmicsSomaticMutationsMatrixDamaging.csv"
CN_PATH        <- "/Users/jkeane/Desktop/Literature Review/OmicsCNGeneWGS.csv"  
MODEL_PATH    <- "/Users/jkeane/Desktop/Literature Review/Model.csv"
LOY_PATH      <- "/Users/jkeane/Desktop/Literature Review/Depmap_YCN_DDX3Y_Expression.csv"
OMICS_PATH    <- "/Users/jkeane/Desktop/Literature Review/OmicsSignatures.csv"
MSI_PATH <- "/Users/jkeane/Desktop/Literature Review/context-explorer-overview.csv"

OUT_VOLCANO   <- "/Users/jkeane/Desktop/Literature Review/volcano_ddx3x_oncogene_hotspots.pdf"

# Copy-number amplification thresholds
ERBB2_AMP_THRESHOLD <- 2.0
CCNE1_AMP_THRESHOLD <- 2.0
CDK4_AMP_THRESHOLD  <- 2.0

```

## #2 Loading Data

This is where I am loading the gene lists.

To test self-dependency of mutations in genes, I create a HOTSPOT_GENES group and grab both the hotspot and CRISPR data. Below, you can see the 10 genes I am testing for self dependency. The additional tests are as follows:

- DDX3X in LOY. Call WT and LOY through uploaded LOY_PATH from Mason, and getting DDX3X CRISPR in CRISPR_TARGETS.

- ERBB2 amplification and self-dependency. Already getting ERBB2 CRISPR from the HOTSPOT_GENES and ERBB2 amplification is being called from the CN path with the ERBB2_AMP_TRESHOLD

- MSI-High vs WRN. WRN CRISPR is called in CRISPR_TARGETS and the MSI_H vs MSI_S is being called through MSI_PATH which is from identified MSI_I cell lines on DepMap Explorer.

- MTAP vs PRMT5. PRMT5 CRISPR is called in CRISPR_TARGETS and MTAP is called for deletion through CN_PATH later with a threshold of 0.4 is homozygous deletion.

- APC damaging vs CTNNB1. CTNNB1 CRISPR is called in HOTSPOT_GENES and APC damaging is called in DAMAGING_GENES.

```{r}
# Gene Lists — NRAS removed
HOTSPOT_GENES <- c(
  "ERBB2"  = "ERBB2 (2064)",  "EGFR"   = "EGFR (1956)",
  "FGFR3"  = "FGFR3 (2261)",  "PIK3CA" = "PIK3CA (5290)",
  "BRAF"   = "BRAF (673)",    "KRAS"   = "KRAS (3845)",
  "CTNNB1" = "CTNNB1 (1499)", "MAP2K1" = "MAP2K1 (5604)",
  "EZH2"   = "EZH2 (2146)"
)
DAMAGING_GENES <- c("APC" = "APC (324)")

CRISPR_TARGETS <- c(
  "DDX3X (1654)", unname(HOTSPOT_GENES),
  "PRMT5 (10419)", "WRN (7486)",
  "PKMYT1 (9088)", "CDK2 (1017)", "CDK4 (1019)"
)
```

Okay so now I am reading the csv in the path.

- **`crispr`** — reads the CRISPR gene effect matrix, renames the first column (which had no header) to `ModelID`, then keeps only the genes you care about from `CRISPR_TARGETS`. Each value is a dependency score — more negative means more essential in that cell line.

- **`model`** — reads the DepMap cell line metadata, keeping only `ModelID` and `Sex`. Used later to filter to male cell lines for the LOY analysis.

- **`ycn`** — reads the Mason lab LOY classification file, keeping `ModelID` and `YCN_ddx3y_expression` which labels each male cell line as either `LOY_low` (lost Y) or `WTY_high` (intact Y).

- **`cn`** — reads the whole-genome sequencing copy number matrix, keeping only ERBB2 and MTAP. ERBB2 values will be thresholded at 2.0 for amplification, MTAP values at 0.4 for homozygous deletion.

- **`msi_ids`** — reads the DepMap context explorer MSI file and pulls just the vector of ModelIDs that are MSI-high. Used later to label cell lines as MSI-high vs MSS.

- **`hotspot_clean`** — reads the hotspot mutation matrix, filters to one row per cell line using `IsDefaultEntryForModel == "Yes"` (avoids duplicate rows from multiple sequencing runs), keeps only your 10 hotspot genes, then renames every gene column to add `_hotspot` suffix (e.g. `KRAS (3845)` becomes `KRAS (3845)_hotspot`) so they don't clash with the CRISPR dependency columns of the same name when joined later.

- **`damaging_clean`** — same logic as hotspot but for loss-of-function damaging mutations in MTAP and APC, with `_damaging` suffix added.

```{r}
# Load & Collapse
crispr <- read_csv(CRISPR_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(ModelID = 1) %>%
  select(ModelID, any_of(CRISPR_TARGETS))

model   <- read_csv(MODEL_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% select(ModelID, Sex)
ycn     <- read_csv(LOY_PATH,   show_col_types = FALSE) %>% select(ModelID, YCN_ddx3y_expression)
cn      <- read_csv(CN_PATH,    show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(ModelID, `ERBB2 (2064)`, `MTAP (4507)`, `CCNE1 (898)`, `CDK4 (1019)`)
msi_ids <- read_csv(MSI_PATH,   show_col_types = FALSE) %>% pull(depmapId)

hotspot_clean <- read_csv(HOTSPOT_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(IsDefaultEntryForModel == "Yes") %>%
  select(ModelID, any_of(unname(HOTSPOT_GENES))) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_hotspot"), -ModelID)

damaging_clean <- read_csv(DAMAGING_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(IsDefaultEntryForModel == "Yes") %>%
  select(ModelID, any_of(unname(DAMAGING_GENES))) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_damaging"), -ModelID)
```

- **`df_full`** — the main analysis table. Joins CRISPR dependency scores with sex metadata, hotspot mutation status, and damaging mutation status for all 1208 cell lines. This is used for all the hotspot self-dependency tests and the APC/CTNNB1 analysis.

- **`df_loy`** — purpose-built for the DDX3X/LOY analysis. Takes only DDX3X CRISPR scores, joins sex and LOY classification, then filters to male cell lines with a known Y chromosome status. Females are excluded because they can't have LOY, and any males without a classification are dropped too.

- **`df_erbb2_amp`** — purpose-built for ERBB2 amplification. Takes ERBB2 CRISPR dependency (renamed to `dep_ERBB2` to be explicit) and joins the ERBB2 copy number (renamed to `erbb2_cn`). Later the copy number column gets thresholded at 2.0 to split cell lines into amplified vs non-amplified.

- **`df_mtap`** — purpose-built for the MTAP/PRMT5 synthetic lethality. Takes PRMT5 CRISPR dependency and joins MTAP copy number. Later MTAP ≤ 0.4 defines homozygous deletion.

- **`df_msi`** — purpose-built for the MSI/WRN analysis. Takes WRN CRISPR dependency (renamed `dep_WRN`) and labels each cell line as `MSI-high` if its ModelID appears in the DepMap MSI list, otherwise `MSS`.

```{r}
#4 Build Analysis Dataframes
df_full <- crispr %>%
  inner_join(model,          by = "ModelID") %>%
  inner_join(hotspot_clean,  by = "ModelID") %>%
  inner_join(damaging_clean, by = "ModelID")

df_loy <- crispr %>%
  select(ModelID, `DDX3X (1654)`) %>%
  inner_join(model, by = "ModelID") %>%
  inner_join(ycn,   by = "ModelID") %>%
  filter(Sex == "Male", YCN_ddx3y_expression %in% c("LOY_low", "WTY_high"))

df_erbb2_amp <- crispr %>%
  select(ModelID, dep_ERBB2 = `ERBB2 (2064)`) %>%
  inner_join(cn %>% rename(erbb2_cn = `ERBB2 (2064)`), by = "ModelID")

df_mtap <- crispr %>%
  select(ModelID, `PRMT5 (10419)`) %>%
  inner_join(cn %>% select(ModelID, `MTAP (4507)`), by = "ModelID")

df_msi <- crispr %>%
  select(ModelID, dep_WRN = `WRN (7486)`) %>%
  mutate(msi_group = if_else(ModelID %in% msi_ids, "MSI-high", "MSS"))

# New: CCNE1 amplification → PKMYT1
df_ccne1_pkmyt1 <- crispr %>%
  select(ModelID, dep_PKMYT1 = `PKMYT1 (9088)`) %>%
  inner_join(cn %>% select(ModelID, ccne1_cn = `CCNE1 (898)`), by = "ModelID")

# New: CCNE1 amplification → CDK2
df_ccne1_cdk2 <- crispr %>%
  select(ModelID, dep_CDK2 = `CDK2 (1017)`) %>%
  inner_join(cn %>% select(ModelID, ccne1_cn = `CCNE1 (898)`), by = "ModelID")

# New: CDK4 amplification → CDK4 self-dependency
df_cdk4_amp <- crispr %>%
  select(ModelID, dep_CDK4 = `CDK4 (1019)`) %>%
  inner_join(cn %>% select(ModelID, cdk4_cn = `CDK4 (1019)`), by = "ModelID")

message(sprintf("df_full: %d models (should be ~1208)", nrow(df_full)))
message(sprintf("df_loy : %d male models",               nrow(df_loy)))
```

## #3 Dependency Test

**`make_result`** is a helper function that takes two groups of CRISPR dependency scores (mutant and wildtype) and runs a statistical test between them, returning a single row of results.

**Inputs:**

- `label` — the name of the comparison (e.g. "KRAS // Hotspot")

- `gene` — the gene name alone (e.g. "KRAS")

- `mut_vals` — vector of CRISPR scores for the biomarker-positive group

- `wt_vals` — vector of CRISPR scores for the biomarker-negative group

- `extra_cols` — optional metadata columns to tag onto the result (e.g. comparison type)

**`if (length(mut_vals) < 3 | length(wt_vals) < 3)`** — safety check. If either group has fewer than 3 cell lines the test is meaningless, so it returns NULL and skips that comparison.

**`wilcox.test(wt_vals, mut_vals, alternative = "greater")`** — runs a one-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test asking: are WT dependency scores significantly greater (less negative) than mutant scores? This is the right test here because dependency scores are non-normally distributed and you have a directional hypothesis — mutant cell lines should be more dependent (more negative scores).

**Output columns:**

- `delta` — median mutant minus median WT. Negative means mutants are more dependent

- `mean_mut` / `mean_wt` — mean scores for each group

- `pval` — p-value from the Wilcoxon test

- `n_mut` / `n_wt` — sample sizes for each group

```{r}
make_result <- function(label, gene, mut_vals, wt_vals, extra_cols = list()) {
  if (length(mut_vals) < 3 | length(wt_vals) < 3) return(NULL)
  wt <- wilcox.test(wt_vals, mut_vals, alternative = "greater")
  bind_cols(
    tibble(
      label    = label,
      gene     = gene,
      delta    = median(mut_vals) - median(wt_vals),
      mean_mut = mean(mut_vals),
      mean_wt  = mean(wt_vals),
      pval     = wt$p.value,
      n_mut    = length(mut_vals),
      n_wt     = length(wt_vals)
    ),
    as_tibble(extra_cols)
  )
}
```

**`run_hotspot_test`** — a function that runs the self-dependency test for a single hotspot gene. For a gene like KRAS it looks up the `_hotspot` column (binary mutation flag) to split cell lines into mutant vs WT, then pulls the CRISPR dependency scores for the same gene and passes both groups to `make_result`. The comment block in the middle is outdated from an earlier version of the code — the suffix logic is now handled cleanly by the `_hotspot` renaming at load time.

**`hotspot_results`** — runs `run_hotspot_test` on all 10 genes in `HOTSPOT_GENES` using `map2_dfr`, which iterates over the gene names and column names in parallel and stacks the results into one table.

**LOY block** — splits `df_loy` into `LOY_low` (lost Y) and `WTY_high` (intact Y) male cell lines, pulls DDX3X CRISPR scores for each group, and passes to `make_result`. `is_loy_ref = TRUE` tags this result for special coloring on the volcano plot.

**ERBB2 amplification block** — splits `df_erbb2_amp` by the `ERBB2_AMP_THRESHOLD` of 2.0, pulling ERBB2 CRISPR scores for amplified vs non-amplified cell lines.

**MSI block** — splits `df_msi` into MSI-high and MSS groups, pulling WRN CRISPR scores for each.

**MTAP block** — splits `df_mtap` at copy number ≤ 0.4 (homozygous deletion) vs \> 0.4, pulling PRMT5 CRISPR scores.

**APC block** — uses `df_full` directly, splitting on `APC (324)_damaging` to get APC-mutant vs WT cell lines, then pulls CTNNB1 CRISPR scores. The rationale is that APC loss activates Wnt/β-catenin signaling, making those cell lines dependent on CTNNB1.

```{r}
# Hotspot self-dependency tests
run_hotspot_test <- function(gene_name, base_col) {
  dep_col_name <- base_col
  hot_col_name <- paste0(base_col, "_hotspot")
  mut_vals <- df_full %>% filter(.data[[hot_col_name]] == 1) %>% pull(.data[[dep_col_name]]) %>% na.omit()
  wt_vals  <- df_full %>% filter(.data[[hot_col_name]] == 0) %>% pull(.data[[dep_col_name]]) %>% na.omit()
  make_result(paste0(gene_name, " // Hotspot"), gene_name, mut_vals, wt_vals,
              list(comparison_type = "hotspot_self", is_loy_ref = FALSE))
}

hotspot_results <- map2_dfr(names(HOTSPOT_GENES), unname(HOTSPOT_GENES), run_hotspot_test)

# DDX3X / LOY
loy_dep <- df_loy %>% filter(YCN_ddx3y_expression == "LOY_low")  %>% pull(`DDX3X (1654)`) %>% na.omit()
wt_dep  <- df_loy %>% filter(YCN_ddx3y_expression == "WTY_high") %>% pull(`DDX3X (1654)`) %>% na.omit()
loy_result <- make_result("DDX3X // LOY", "DDX3X", loy_dep, wt_dep,
                          list(comparison_type = "loy", is_loy_ref = TRUE))

# ERBB2 amplification
amp_vals <- df_erbb2_amp %>% filter(erbb2_cn >= ERBB2_AMP_THRESHOLD) %>% pull(dep_ERBB2) %>% na.omit()
non_amp  <- df_erbb2_amp %>% filter(erbb2_cn <  ERBB2_AMP_THRESHOLD) %>% pull(dep_ERBB2) %>% na.omit()
erbb2_amp_result <- make_result("ERBB2 // Amplification", "ERBB2", amp_vals, non_amp,
                                list(comparison_type = "cn_amp", is_loy_ref = FALSE))

# MSI-high / WRN
msi_vals <- df_msi %>% filter(msi_group == "MSI-high") %>% pull(dep_WRN) %>% na.omit()
mss_vals <- df_msi %>% filter(msi_group == "MSS")      %>% pull(dep_WRN) %>% na.omit()
msi_result <- make_result("WRN // MSI-high", "WRN", msi_vals, mss_vals,
                          list(comparison_type = "msi", is_loy_ref = FALSE))

# MTAP deletion / PRMT5
mtap_del <- df_mtap %>% filter(`MTAP (4507)` <= 0.4) %>% pull(`PRMT5 (10419)`) %>% na.omit()
mtap_wt  <- df_mtap %>% filter(`MTAP (4507)` >  0.4) %>% pull(`PRMT5 (10419)`) %>% na.omit()
mtap_result <- make_result("PRMT5 // MTAP del", "PRMT5", mtap_del, mtap_wt,
                           list(comparison_type = "cn_del", is_loy_ref = FALSE))

# APC damaging / CTNNB1
apc_mut <- df_full %>% filter(`APC (324)_damaging` == 1) %>% pull(`CTNNB1 (1499)`) %>% na.omit()
apc_wt  <- df_full %>% filter(`APC (324)_damaging` == 0) %>% pull(`CTNNB1 (1499)`) %>% na.omit()
apc_result <- make_result("CTNNB1 // APC damaging", "CTNNB1", apc_mut, apc_wt,
                          list(comparison_type = "damaging", is_loy_ref = FALSE))

# NEW: CCNE1 amplification → PKMYT1
ccne1_amp_pkmyt1 <- df_ccne1_pkmyt1 %>% filter(ccne1_cn >= CCNE1_AMP_THRESHOLD) %>% pull(dep_PKMYT1) %>% na.omit()
ccne1_wt_pkmyt1  <- df_ccne1_pkmyt1 %>% filter(ccne1_cn <  CCNE1_AMP_THRESHOLD) %>% pull(dep_PKMYT1) %>% na.omit()
ccne1_pkmyt1_result <- make_result("PKMYT1 // CCNE1 Amp", "PKMYT1", ccne1_amp_pkmyt1, ccne1_wt_pkmyt1,
                                   list(comparison_type = "cn_amp", is_loy_ref = FALSE))

# NEW: CCNE1 amplification → CDK2
ccne1_amp_cdk2 <- df_ccne1_cdk2 %>% filter(ccne1_cn >= CCNE1_AMP_THRESHOLD) %>% pull(dep_CDK2) %>% na.omit()
ccne1_wt_cdk2  <- df_ccne1_cdk2 %>% filter(ccne1_cn <  CCNE1_AMP_THRESHOLD) %>% pull(dep_CDK2) %>% na.omit()
ccne1_cdk2_result <- make_result("CDK2 // CCNE1 Amp", "CDK2", ccne1_amp_cdk2, ccne1_wt_cdk2,
                                 list(comparison_type = "cn_amp", is_loy_ref = FALSE))

# NEW: CDK4 amplification → CDK4 self-dependency
cdk4_amp_vals <- df_cdk4_amp %>% filter(cdk4_cn >= CDK4_AMP_THRESHOLD) %>% pull(dep_CDK4) %>% na.omit()
cdk4_wt_vals  <- df_cdk4_amp %>% filter(cdk4_cn <  CDK4_AMP_THRESHOLD) %>% pull(dep_CDK4) %>% na.omit()
cdk4_amp_result <- make_result("CDK4 // Amplification", "CDK4", cdk4_amp_vals, cdk4_wt_vals,
                               list(comparison_type = "cn_amp", is_loy_ref = FALSE))
```

- **`bind_rows`** — stacks all 15 individual test results (10 hotspot, LOY, ERBB2 amp, MSI, MTAP, APC) into a single table.

- **`neg_log2_p`** — computes -log2(pval) for each result. This is used for the volcano plot y-axis — more significant results plot higher. Note this uses log2 rather than the more common log10, so the scale will look different from typical volcano plots.

- **`significant`** — a simple TRUE/FALSE flag for whether the BH-adjusted p-value passes the 0.05 threshold.

- **`arrange(pval)`** — sorts the table by raw p-value so the strongest results appear first, giving you the ranked table you've been looking at.

- **`print`** — displays just the five most informative columns: the comparison label, effect size (delta), p-value, and group sizes. This is the results table you've been validating throughout.

```{r}
results <- bind_rows(
  hotspot_results,
  loy_result,
  erbb2_amp_result,
  msi_result,
  mtap_result,
  apc_result,
  ccne1_pkmyt1_result,
  ccne1_cdk2_result,
  cdk4_amp_result
) %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log2_p  = -log2(pval),
    significant = pval < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(pval)

print(results %>% dplyr::select(label, delta, pval, n_mut, n_wt))
```

## #4 Printing Results

```{r}

always_label <- c(
  results %>% arrange(pval) %>% slice_head(n = 5) %>% pull(label),
  "PRMT5 // MTAP del",
  "WRN // MSI-high"
) %>% unique()

results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    color = case_when(
      is_loy_ref                                    ~ "#c7615a",
      pval < 0.01 & delta < -0.1 & mean_mut < -0.3 ~ "#7e95bf",
      TRUE                                          ~ "gray"
    ),
    p_star_label = case_when(
      pval < 0.0001 ~ "****",
      pval < 0.001  ~ "***",
      pval < 0.01   ~ "**",
      pval < 0.05   ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ "ns"
    )
  )

volcano_plot <- ggplot(results,
                       aes(x = delta, y = -log10(pval), label = label)) +
  geom_point(aes(size  = abs(delta),
                 color = color),
             shape = 16, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  geom_text_repel(
    data          = ~ subset(.x, label %in% always_label),
    aes(label     = label, color = color),
    size               = 6,
    box.padding        = 0.75,
    point.padding      = 1,
    min.segment.length = 0.75
  ) +
  theme_tufte(base_size = 24) +
  theme(axis.text       = element_text(color = "black"),
        legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = "\u2206 Median Dependency",
       y = "-log10(p-value)")
```

```{r}

top7_labels <- results %>%
  arrange(delta) %>%
  slice_head(n = 7) %>%
  pull(label)

# Build long-format data for all comparison types
hotspot_long <- map2_dfr(names(HOTSPOT_GENES), unname(HOTSPOT_GENES), function(gene_name, base_col) {
  dep_col <- base_col
  hot_col <- paste0(base_col, "_hotspot")
  df_full %>%
    select(ModelID, dep = all_of(dep_col), status = all_of(hot_col)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(dep), status %in% c(0, 1)) %>%
    mutate(label            = paste0(gene_name, " // Hotspot"),
           biomarker_binary = if_else(status == 1, "biomarker", "non_biomarker"))
})

loy_long <- df_loy %>%
  select(ModelID, dep = `DDX3X (1654)`, YCN_ddx3y_expression) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dep)) %>%
  mutate(label            = "DDX3X // LOY",
         biomarker_binary = if_else(YCN_ddx3y_expression == "LOY_low",
                                    "highlighted_biomarker", "non_biomarker")) %>%
  select(ModelID, dep, label, biomarker_binary)

erbb2_amp_long <- df_erbb2_amp %>%
  filter(!is.na(dep_ERBB2), !is.na(erbb2_cn)) %>%
  mutate(label            = "ERBB2 // Amplification",
         biomarker_binary = if_else(erbb2_cn >= ERBB2_AMP_THRESHOLD,
                                    "biomarker", "non_biomarker")) %>%
  select(ModelID, dep = dep_ERBB2, label, biomarker_binary)

msi_long <- df_msi %>%
  filter(!is.na(dep_WRN)) %>%
  mutate(label            = "WRN // MSI-high",
         biomarker_binary = if_else(msi_group == "MSI-high",
                                    "biomarker", "non_biomarker")) %>%
  select(ModelID, dep = dep_WRN, label, biomarker_binary)

mtap_long <- df_mtap %>%
  filter(!is.na(`MTAP (4507)`), !is.na(`PRMT5 (10419)`)) %>%
  mutate(label            = "PRMT5 // MTAP del",
         biomarker_binary = case_when(
           `MTAP (4507)` <= 0.4 ~ "biomarker",
           `MTAP (4507)` >  0.4 ~ "non_biomarker"
         )) %>%
  dplyr::select(ModelID, dep = `PRMT5 (10419)`, label, biomarker_binary)

apc_long <- df_full %>%
  select(ModelID, dep = `CTNNB1 (1499)`, status = `APC (324)_damaging`) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dep), status %in% c(0, 1)) %>%
  mutate(label            = "CTNNB1 // APC damaging",
         biomarker_binary = if_else(status == 1, "biomarker", "non_biomarker"))

# NEW: CCNE1 amp → PKMYT1
ccne1_pkmyt1_long <- df_ccne1_pkmyt1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(dep_PKMYT1), !is.na(ccne1_cn)) %>%
  mutate(label            = "PKMYT1 // CCNE1 Amp",
         biomarker_binary = if_else(ccne1_cn >= CCNE1_AMP_THRESHOLD,
                                    "biomarker", "non_biomarker")) %>%
  select(ModelID, dep = dep_PKMYT1, label, biomarker_binary)

# NEW: CCNE1 amp → CDK2
ccne1_cdk2_long <- df_ccne1_cdk2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(dep_CDK2), !is.na(ccne1_cn)) %>%
  mutate(label            = "CDK2 // CCNE1 Amp",
         biomarker_binary = if_else(ccne1_cn >= CCNE1_AMP_THRESHOLD,
                                    "biomarker", "non_biomarker")) %>%
  select(ModelID, dep = dep_CDK2, label, biomarker_binary)

# NEW: CDK4 amp → CDK4
cdk4_amp_long <- df_cdk4_amp %>%
  filter(!is.na(dep_CDK4), !is.na(cdk4_cn)) %>%
  mutate(label            = "CDK4 // Amplification",
         biomarker_binary = if_else(cdk4_cn >= CDK4_AMP_THRESHOLD,
                                    "biomarker", "non_biomarker")) %>%
  select(ModelID, dep = dep_CDK4, label, biomarker_binary)

# Combine & filter to top 7
long_df <- bind_rows(
  hotspot_long, loy_long, erbb2_amp_long,
  msi_long, mtap_long, apc_long,
  ccne1_pkmyt1_long, ccne1_cdk2_long, cdk4_amp_long
) %>%
  filter(label %in% top7_labels) %>%
  mutate(biomarker_binary = factor(biomarker_binary,
                                   levels = c("highlighted_biomarker",
                                              "biomarker",
                                              "non_biomarker")))

label_order <- results %>%
  arrange(delta) %>%
  filter(label %in% top7_labels) %>%
  pull(label)

long_df <- long_df %>%
  mutate(vulnerability = factor(label, levels = label_order))

results_ordered <- results %>%
  filter(label %in% top7_labels) %>%
  mutate(
    vulnerability = factor(label, levels = label_order),
    p_star_label  = case_when(
      pval < 0.0001 ~ "****",
      pval < 0.001  ~ "***",
      pval < 0.01   ~ "**",
      pval < 0.05   ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ "ns"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(vulnerability)

boxplot_ticks <- expand.grid(
  vulnerability    = levels(long_df$vulnerability),
  biomarker_binary = c("biomarker", "non_biomarker")
) %>%
  arrange(vulnerability, biomarker_binary) %>%
  mutate(
    x    = rep(seq_along(levels(long_df$vulnerability)), each = 2) + c(-0.175, 0.175),
    gene = gsub(" //.*", "", as.character(vulnerability)),
    label = case_when(
      biomarker_binary == "non_biomarker" & vulnerability == "DDX3X // LOY"           ~ "Y WT",
      biomarker_binary == "biomarker"     & vulnerability == "DDX3X // LOY"           ~ "LOY",
      biomarker_binary == "non_biomarker" & vulnerability == "ERBB2 // Amplification" ~ "ERBB2 WT",
      biomarker_binary == "biomarker"     & vulnerability == "ERBB2 // Amplification" ~ "ERBB2 Amp",
      biomarker_binary == "non_biomarker" & vulnerability == "WRN // MSI-high"        ~ "MSS",
      biomarker_binary == "biomarker"     & vulnerability == "WRN // MSI-high"        ~ "MSI-high",
      biomarker_binary == "non_biomarker" & vulnerability == "PRMT5 // MTAP del"      ~ "MTAP WT",
      biomarker_binary == "biomarker"     & vulnerability == "PRMT5 // MTAP del"      ~ "MTAP del",
      biomarker_binary == "non_biomarker" & vulnerability == "CTNNB1 // APC damaging" ~ "APC WT",
      biomarker_binary == "biomarker"     & vulnerability == "CTNNB1 // APC damaging" ~ "APC dam.",
      biomarker_binary == "non_biomarker" & vulnerability == "PKMYT1 // CCNE1 Amp"   ~ "CCNE1 WT",
      biomarker_binary == "biomarker"     & vulnerability == "PKMYT1 // CCNE1 Amp"   ~ "CCNE1 Amp",
      biomarker_binary == "non_biomarker" & vulnerability == "CDK2 // CCNE1 Amp"     ~ "CCNE1 WT",
      biomarker_binary == "biomarker"     & vulnerability == "CDK2 // CCNE1 Amp"     ~ "CCNE1 Amp",
      biomarker_binary == "non_biomarker" & vulnerability == "CDK4 // Amplification" ~ "CDK4 WT",
      biomarker_binary == "biomarker"     & vulnerability == "CDK4 // Amplification" ~ "CDK4 Amp",
      biomarker_binary == "non_biomarker" ~ paste0(gene, " WT"),
      biomarker_binary == "biomarker"     ~ paste0(gene, " Mut")
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(x_num = as.numeric(factor(vulnerability, levels = levels(long_df$vulnerability))))

brackets <- boxplot_ticks %>%
  group_by(vulnerability) %>%
  summarise(xmin = min(x_num) - 0.2,
            xmax = max(x_num) + 0.2,
            y    = -4.05)

COLS <- c("biomarker"             = "#7e95bf",
          "non_biomarker"         = "#b4b4b5",
          "highlighted_biomarker" = "#c7615a")

boxplot_plot7 <- ggplot(long_df,
                        aes(x     = vulnerability,
                            y     = dep,
                            fill  = biomarker_binary,
                            color = biomarker_binary)) +
  geom_boxplot(width         = 0.5,
               alpha         = 0.5,
               outlier.shape = NA,
               position      = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  geom_point(shape    = 16,
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.4, dodge.width = 0.7),
             alpha    = 0.35,
             size     = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = COLS, name = "Biomarker") +
  scale_color_manual(values = COLS, name = "Biomarker") +
  geom_text(data        = results_ordered,
            aes(x       = vulnerability, y = 1.15, label = p_star_label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  theme_tufte(base_size = 24) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Dependency Score") +
  theme(axis.text       = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 0, margin = margin(t = 110)),
        axis.ticks.x    = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none") +
  geom_segment(data = boxplot_ticks,
               aes(x = x, xend = x, y = -4.1, yend = -4.20),
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data        = boxplot_ticks,
            aes(x       = x, y = -4.25, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            angle       = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1) +
  geom_segment(data = brackets,
               aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = 1.07, yend = 1.07),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
```
